anomalies.description: A sudden, intense bright flash erupts from the object, followed by rapid expansion of a fireball and smoke plume, characteristic of a high-energy explosion.

Sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of smoke/dust cloud, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event; visible in frames f0–f2.; Continued violent disintegration and debris ejection after the initial blast; the structure is obliterated and obscured by dense smoke and fire, indicating ongoing explosive fragmentation.
Indistinct figures appear to engage in close physical struggle amid smoke; motion suggests grappling or striking (frames f5–f11), though low resolution limits certainty.
Sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of luminous gas/cloud, consistent with a detonation event; visible in frames f0–f3.
Secondary bright flash and expanding fireball with smoke plume, indicating a second explosive event or continuation of the first; visible in frames f4–f6.
One figure appears stationary or fallen while another looms over them in frames f11–f15; possible targeting of a helpless individual, but visibility is extremely poor.
Third distinct flash and rising smoke/fire column, suggesting another detonation or sustained combustion after initial blasts; visible in frames f9–f12.
